summary: Remote-controlled Claude Code agent driven by hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: The package ships a single `mars` bin that, when the user runs it, opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay `wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay` and dispatches messages received over that relay into `child_process.spawn` invocations of the `claude` CLI on the local host. Any party able to send messages through the relay can drive Claude Code tool calls, approvals, and file edits on the operator's machine, yielding arbitrary command execution and filesystem modification under the operator's account. The relay hostname is hardcoded with no authentication, pinning, or destination-configuration mechanism visible in the bundle, so the trust boundary is entirely the operator of `cho100.cn`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
